breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained conflicting instructions, specifying both 'time_integration: Explicit forward Euler' and 'method: Strang splitting'. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The agent failed to fix this and instead incorrectly combined the conflicting instructions, stating 'Implement Strang splitting with explicit forward Euler time integration', which perpetuates the original error.
